Premise: holds in part (area read at origin/main 0465f4aa). The card already pins two dataset names under `expect.datasets` (`trip_plan`, `reimbursement`) and the build prompt states them word for word (`runner/prompts.ts` `datasetLines`). The collision comes from a THIRD dataset the build invents for the report the prompt asks for ("a report of travel spend by department and expense type"): the verified build (template b7ab31a7) declares `travel_spend` on `claim_line`, label "Travel spend". The matcher (`service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts`) compares member name, label and synonyms only, so the word still matches the same two members there; the collision is at the agent, which reads a dataset called "Travel spend" and answers from it instead of asking back. So the route is the card's first option, extended to the report: the card pins the report's dataset too (a name and label that do not equal the ambiguous word), and the report sentence names that dataset, so no build has a reason to name one after the word. `check-governed-merges --test` on the surface: NOT governed.
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches the card file; overlap-check before push. Then one fresh travel_expense build on main (seat ruling 2026-11-17T20:34Z) and #34920 commits it as the fixture.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:devx`, routed to area o3-F by the seat (2026-11-17T20:33Z).
Pre-claim deps: none open.
Prior rulings read: scenarios,travel_expense,pins,dataset,names,build,collide,ambiguous,word,measures → 139 hits; ADR-0149 D6 (every key names its reader: no new key here, the card reuses `expect.datasets`), others off-topic; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

Lease `o3-F` (seat post #34584); child of epic #34659.

Close-out · area o3-F · 2026-11-18T03:00Z · Done-when met: two fresh builds give the ambiguous word the same matches

Two scratch builds of the changed card (PR #34981) on main `3b4ffb22` (card sha256 `44903e7f…`), same flags as the 2026-11-17 verified build: opus low author, haiku medium ask, published 18.5.0, subscription login. Records: `/mnt/project-files/issue-34896/builds/{b1,b2}/` (run.log, out/, scratch.rec.json, snap/ of each `dist/objectstack.json`).

| | b1 | b2 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Build | success, 39 turns, 7m 39s | success, 53 turns, 8m 11s |
| Datasets | `claim_lines`, `reimbursement`, `trip_plan` (the card's pinned names; no `travel_spend`) | same three |
| `travel spend` / `差旅花费` match (equal name, label or synonym) | `reimbursement.claimed_amount`, `trip_plan.estimated_spend` | `reimbursement.claimed_amount`, `trip_plan.estimated_spend` |
| Seed | 757/757 | 757/757 |
| Run-问数 | 11/13 | 13/13 |
| Run-operations | 4/6 | 5/6 |
| Author cost | $4.77 | $5.29 |

- The match sets are identical: two measures in two datasets, so `dq_travel_spend` asks back in both, as written. b2's live `list_datasets({terms:["travel spend","差旅花费"]})` answered exactly those two matches; b1's agent never sent the whole phrase, so its set is read off the build's own synonyms with the door's equality rule.
- Submit action: both builds author `demotravel_submit_claim` declaratively (`type: script`, `operation: update`, `patch: {status: submitted}`). The `HOOK_ABORTED` submit of template `b7ab31a7` (a script body passing `status` as an update option) does not recur, so no skills finding. b2's `file_and_submit_from_text` passes; b1's fails only the per-unit line-shape check (`expense_type="meals", quantity=3, unit_amount=115` -> 0 rows), which #35025 / PR #35044 replaces with per-type sums. Both fail `manager_approves_step_one` on step 2's approver (`e14` read, `e13` declared): not this card's surface.
- Total spend $10.46 of the $50 approved (author $4.77 + $5.29, asks $0.20 + $0.20).
- For whoever takes #34920 (released to the pool): b2 is a fresh build of the current card on current main with the right submit form and full seed; its snapshot is `b2/snap/025744-b26fb467752d4678.json`.

Closing as completed. Lease cleared.
